customManagers.description: Propose updates to the pinned yoziru/tesla-ble git dependency. Each update requires an explicitly authorized migration, patch rebase and protocol-vector review; dependency updates never auto-merge.
Bump the tag and immutable digest of the shared ESP-IDF build image
Notify about a new esptool-js release for the browser installer. The bump fails the vendored-runtime hash gate until the bundle, its notices and their pins are re-vendored and reviewed.

packageRules.description: Tracked firmware and installer dependencies require manual review, relevant protocol/runtime tests and separately authorized physical acceptance. CI success alone is not hardware evidence. Among GitHub Actions, only renovatebot/github-action is managed and eligible for the configured automerge; build and publication action pins remain manually reviewed trust boundaries.
Keep ESP-IDF on 6.x, and remind maintainers that an IDF bump also moves the Mbed TLS / TF-PSA-Crypto the PSA patch and host harness are pinned against.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ **Before merging — re-verify the tesla-ble PSA port.** An ESP-IDF bump changes the Mbed TLS / TF-PSA-Crypto the firmware links, and the firmware build fails closed until `MBEDTLS_REF` in scripts/test-tesla-ble-harness.sh and `MBEDTLS_COMMIT` in scripts/check-dependency-contract.py name the new image's components/mbedtls/mbedtls commit. Update both, rerun the V1 protocol vectors, and re-check patches/tesla-ble/0006-port-crypto-bindings-to-psa.patch (docs/adr/0002-idf6-mbedtls4-crypto-seam.md). Do not widen `allowedVersions` to 7.x as a routine bump. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#esp-idf-migration-inputs for the complete lockfile, workflow, resource-baseline, version-literal and X509-bundle fan-out.

packageRules.description: Only renovatebot/github-action in renovate.yaml is managed by Renovate; build and release workflow actions are pinned security boundaries audited in scripts/check-workflow-policy.py.
